Write one feedback file per student

Source: R/feedback.R
export_feedback.Rd

Writes <student>.md into dir for every student: the total score, the score of each exercise, and the status of each test, with the error message when there is one. Use it to send each student their results.

Usage

export_feedback(results, dir, scoring = c("partial", "all"), weights = NULL)

Arguments

results

A grade_results object.

dir

Folder to write into. Created if needed.

scoring, weights

Passed to student_scores().

Value

The paths of the written files, invisibly.

Examples

dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "feedback")
paths <- export_feedback(example_results(), dir)
writeLines(readLines(paths[[1]]))
#> # Garcia
#> 
#> Total score: 80%
#> 
#> ## ejercicio1: 100%
#> 
#> - `test_ejercicio1_case1`: pass

#>

#>

#>

#>
